newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt rally continues as short rates.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt rally continues as short rates.

text.p: Norway's debt market rallied for the third consecutive session, with dealers focused on the strong crown and falling forward rate agreements (FRAs), as well as money market rates.
"Clearly, the crown is staging the show," said one dealer.
Norway's central bank on Tuesday announced a 50 basis point rate cut to try and dampen the rapid appreciation of the Norwegian currency.
However, the crown reached new heights at 101.15 versus the European Currency Unit in early trade on Thursday. It retraced to 101.4 as profit-taking emerged in late dealing.
Players said bond prices could continue to climb near-term as positions were tight on expectations of a further fall in interest rates.
"There are not many (bond) sellers, everybody is afraid to miss the next rate cut," said one analyst.
